tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current openings that companies publish on rolefig, across every company. Filter by keywords (q), workplace, employment type, country (ISO code), region (a code such as CA), company slug, postedWithin (7 or 30 days) and minPay (minimum annual USD); sort by newest or pay. tools.name: list_published_companies
tools.description: Discover company-published profiles with search and cursor pagination. Use the returned slug with get_published_company or list_company_openings. Public company information only; no applicant data.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one current published opening in full, with its company profile, the company's application URL and its rolefig page. Use the company and job slugs from search_jobs. Compensation text is authoritative; absent numeric pay and units are unknown. Never submits an application.

tools.name: get_published_company
tools.description: Read a real company-published profile and its current published openings. Includes the company's stated facts (social profiles, headquarters, size, founding year, benefits, workplace policy, hiring process), how rolefig verified it, and source and application URLs; no applicant data or application s

tools.name: list_company_openings
tools.description: Read current published openings for a known company slug, with application URLs and the publication revision. Excludes drafts and closed jobs. Never submits an application.

tools.name: demo_search_jobs
tools.description: Demo catalog: illustrative roles, applications closed. Search the sample roles by keywords, company, work arrangement and minimum annual USD base salary. For real openings use search_jobs.

tools.name: demo_list_companies
tools.description: Demo catalog: illustrative roles, applications closed. List the sample companies and their role counts.

tools.name: demo_get_job
tools.description: Demo catalog: illustrative roles, applications closed. Read a sample role and its company profile.

tools.name: demo_get_company
tools.description: Demo catalog: illustrative roles, applications closed. Read a sample company profile and its roles.

tools.name: format_resume
tools.description: Format ONLY candidate-supplied facts into resume text. Does not generate claims, save data, or submit an application. Remote use sends these fields to rolefig for formatting; omit contact details unless the candidate wants them included.

tools.name: convert_pay
tools.description: Convert one gross pay figure (USD) between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly for a stated schedule. Overtime hours are paid at 1.5x the base rate; `hour` blends base and overtime. Gross pay only: no taxes, benefits or deductions.

tools.name: check_pay_transparency
tools.description: Check a US job post against state and city pay-range posting laws (table checked 2026-10-05) for the job's state, optional city or county, total employer size and remote status. tools.name: check_job_posting
tools.description: Check a job post's schema.org JobPosting markup against Google's job search rules. Returns blocking errors, recommended fixes and a summary per posting, never the page itself. Pass the page HTML or JSON-LD as `html`, or a public page address as `url`.

tools.name: render_contract
tools.description: Fill rolefig's California starter offer letter and pay plan (commission, salary with bonus, or hourly) from values the employer confirmed, or fill the employer's own contract through {{placeholders}}. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, get_published_company, list_company_openings, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Private data: format_resume, render_contract · Public sink: search_jobs, format_resume, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Destructive: format_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, get_published_company, list_company_openings, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Private data: format_resume, render_contract · Public sink: search_jobs, format_resume, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Destructive: format_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
